text: Agent Prompt 是面向 DSH web 客户端的插件，会在左侧栏提供一个指令文件管理面板。面板列出用户全局及已注册工作区对应的 AGENTS.md，显示文件状态并支持筛选；选中条目后可读取正文、编辑草稿、撤销重做、重新加载和保存。宿主根据 DSH_HOME 或默认 ~/.dsh 定位全局文件，并从工作区项目根定位工作区文件。适合希望直接在 DSH 中维护 agent 指令的用户；无需 API key 或外部账号。

Agent Prompt adds a sidebar panel to DSH web for managing user-global and workspace AGENTS.md files. Browse and filter the file tree, read or edit text, then save with undo and reload controls. It uses DSH_HOME or ~/.dsh for the global file; no API key or external account is needed.
想在 DSH 侧栏里直接修改全局和各工作区的 AGENTS.md。

Agent Prompt 的功能「浏览并编辑指令文件」：侧栏面板展示全局与已注册工作区的 AGENTS.md，可筛选、读取和修改正文；点击 Save 或使用快捷键即可写回。

dsh-agent-prompt README · dsh-agent-prompt：**Agent Prompt** — edit the `AGENTS.md` instruction files DeepSeek Harness
actually loads, from a panel in the GUI's left sidebar.

dsh-agent-prompt README · dsh-agent-prompt：DSH seeds every session with workspace guidance taken from `AGENTS.md`-compatible
files: one user-global file plus a project chain. Those files normally get edited
in an external editor, in a terminal, one path at a time. This plugin puts them
in one page: a tree of every global and per-workspace instruction file on the
left, a plain text editor on the right, and a Save button that writes the exact
bytes the agent will read next session.

dsh-agent-prompt README · dsh-agent-prompt：```
┌── Agent Prompt ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Filter workspaces…    │  ~/workspace/dsh-plugins/AGENTS.md                │
│                        │    ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  GLOBAL                │    │ Save  Reload │ Undo Redo │ Wrap           │  │

dsh-agent-prompt README · What it contributes：| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| Sidebar row **Agent Prompt** | a global panel row in the icon rail, directly under **Schedules** |
| The **Agent Prompt** page | left tree (global + one node per registered workspace, with a filter) and a right editor |
| `GET /api/agent-prompt/tree` | the resolved file list with per-file existence, size and mtime |
| `GET /api/agent-prompt/file?key=…` | read one instruction file |
| `POST /api/agent-prompt/file` | write one instruction file, creating it and its directory when missing |

dsh-agent-prompt README · What it contributes：Those are **host** paths and stay absolute; the panel asks for them relative to
the document (`AGENT_PROMPT_CLIENT_API`, derived from `AGENT_PROMPT_API` by
`clientPath()` in `src/protocol.ts`). The distinction matters wherever the client
is not at the origin root: `dsh-remote-control` serves it at `/s/<sessionId>/`,
and an absolute `/api/…` request would leave that prefix and be answered by its
host — a `200 text/html` page that this panel would read as a body-less success
because `request()` tolerates a non-JSON body. `test/protocol.spec.ts` resolves
both forms against a mounted base to pin it.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Which files it edits, and why those：The host half resolves paths with the same rules as
[`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions),
the package that loads these files. Its shipped defaults are
`projectRootMarkers: ['.git']`, `instructionFileCandidates: ['AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md']`
and `dshHome: $DSH_HOME || ~/.dsh`; the `agent-instructions` row in
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` sets only `maxBytes`, so no path in this deployment is
overridden.
section: Which files it edits, and why those

text:
dsh-agent-prompt README · Which files it edits, and why those：| Node | Resolution |
|---|---|
| **User-global** | `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`, falling back to `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`. An empty or blank `$DSH_HOME` counts as unset, matching the loader. |
| **A workspace** | Walk up from the registered workspace directory to the first ancestor containing `.git`; the file is `<that directory>/AGENTS.md`. With no marker anywhere the walk ends at the workspace directory itself. |
section: Which files it edits, and why those

text:
dsh-agent-prompt README · Which files it edits, and why those：The tree shows the resolved absolute path for each node, and marks a file
`not created` when it does not exist yet — saving creates it. A workspace whose
project root differs from its directory (a monorepo package, say) is shown
against its repository root, not the package.
section: Which files it edits, and why those

text:
dsh-agent-prompt README · Which files it edits, and why those：**Only `AGENTS.md` is offered.** The loader also accepts `CLAUDE.md`,
`AGENTS.local.md` and `CLAUDE.local.md` at every level of the project chain, and
edits them too. Those are out of scope here; this panel is deliberately one file
per scope.

text:
dsh-agent-prompt README · The page：Registrations, both keyed `agentPrompt`:

| Slot | Registration | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `sidebar.panellist` | `id: 'agentPrompt'`, `order: 11` | the icon row |
| `main` | `key: 'agentPrompt'` | the page the row opens in the centre column |

The page title carries the panel's version and the author credit — `Agent Prompt
v0.1.3 Author: icrefin [icrefinai@gmail.com]` — as a muted tag beside the
`20px/500` title, matching `dsh-skill-mgr` and `dsh-mcp-mgr`.

dsh-agent-prompt README · The page：Unlike those two, **the number is inlined into the browser bundle at build time**
rather than fetched from the host. The two halves of a plugin do not update
together: the browser bundle is re-imported the moment its revision changes,
while the host half is a boot-time ESM import that keeps serving the code the
process started with. A host-sourced tag therefore goes blank as soon as the
client gets ahead of the running host — which is exactly how this panel once
rendered a bare `v`. `tsdown.config.ts` reads `package.json` and defines
`__DSH_AGENT_PROMPT_VERSION__`; `src/client/version.ts` exports it, and the tag is
skipped when it is empty.

dsh-agent-prompt README · The page：Selecting the row is `ctx.layout.selectPanel('agentPrompt')`, a lookup in the
live `main` registry, so the two share the id by construction. `dsh.client.inject`
orders the bundle after `dsh-client-ui-sidebar` and `dsh-client-ui-layout`, the
packages that declare those two slots.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Editor commands：| Command | Shortcut | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Save | `⌘S` / `Ctrl+S` **anywhere on the page** | disabled until the draft differs from disk |
| Reload | — | discards the draft and re-reads the file; guarded by a confirm when dirty |
| Undo / Redo | `⌘Z` / `⇧⌘Z` (native) | a local history, since the platform stack cannot be driven from a button; a typing burst collapses into one step |
| Wrap | — | soft wrap on/off, remembered in `localStorage` |

dsh-agent-prompt README · Editor commands：The clipboard gets **no buttons at all**: `⌘X`, `⌘C`, `⌘V` and `⌘A` already reach
the focused textarea, and a toolbar duplicate of a working platform shortcut is
noise. What is left is exactly the set the textarea cannot reach by itself.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Style contract：- **Colour is `--dsw-alias-*` only** — the stylesheet contains no literal hex and
  no non-alias token. State chips are their state colour on a 10%
  `color-mix(… transparent)` tint; surfaces are `bg-layer-1` (the tree column),
  `bg-layer-3` (the editor field) and `bg-module-platform` (the filter, chips).
- **Buttons** are the contract's two families: neutral is a bare 8px/12.5px
  control that fills with `interactive-bg-hover` → `-active`, and the primary Save
  uses `button-primary-fill`/`-hover` with `label-primary-foreground`.
  `brand-primary` appears only as the `:focus-visible` outline — never as a fill.
- **Type and geometry**: 20px/500/28 title, 13px/20 intro, 11px chips; the header
  owns `padding-top: 28px` plus `--dsh-frame-top-clearance` under Darwin, and the
  page's horizontal rhythm is `clamp(24px, 4vw, 48px)`.
- **`color-scheme: light dark`** on the page root, with no dark-mode overrides: the
  tokens carry both modes.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Style contract：The two-pane body is the one deliberate departure: the contract describes a
centred 960px column page, which would starve a tree-plus-editor split. The header
keeps the contract's inset so the title lines up with its sibling panels, and the
body is full-bleed beneath it.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Style contract：The editor is a plain monospace `<textarea>`: no Markdown preview, no syntax
highlighting. Switching files with unsaved changes asks first, and closing the
window with unsaved changes triggers the browser's own unload prompt. Saving or
reloading starts a fresh undo history, so Undo can never walk back to a body the
host never saw.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Install：The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so installs go through
**Settings → Plugins** (or the plugin-manager tool); `dsh plugin add` refuses that
profile.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build                              # tsc -> lib/, tsdown -> lib/client.js
npm pack --pack-destination dist        # dist/dsh-agent-prompt-0.1.2.tgz
```

dsh-agent-prompt README · Install：Then add `dist/dsh-agent-prompt-0.1.2.tgz` from the Plugins page. The bundle is
recorded in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` and its `cordis.patch.yml` insert
row mounts the host half; the `dsh.client` manifest field loads the browser half.

Two operational notes:

dsh-agent-prompt README · Install：- **Reinstalling the same version is a no-op.** pnpm sees an unchanged spec and
  leaves the extracted copy in `node_modules` alone, so a rebuilt tarball at the
  same version does not reach the profile. Remove the bundle first, then install
  it again — or bump the version.
- **A first install needs no restart; an update of a loaded plugin does for
  host-side changes.** On the first install the host routes mounted and the browser
  half registered as soon as the install finished, with no page refresh. After that
  the two halves diverge: the browser bundle is re-imported on its new revision,
  but the **host half is a boot-time ESM import** and keeps serving the code the
  process started with. A host-side change — a new route field, say — reaches the
  running app only on the next start; client-side changes never need one. This is
  upstream behaviour, not this plugin's: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr` states that
  "replacing installed package versions still requires a restart". Restart if an
  entry reports `failed to import`.

dsh-agent-prompt README · HTTP API：Both routes are registered on `ctx.webServer` and carry a **loopback-only fence**:
the write route rewrites a file the agent reads as instructions, so a
LAN-exposed `dsh web` deployment must not serve it. Requests are additionally
capped at 4 MiB.

```
GET  /api/agent-prompt/tree
     -> { dshHome, homeDisplay, global: Node, workspaces: Node[], skipped: string[] }

GET  /api/agent-prompt/file?key=global|ws:<workspaceId>

dsh-agent-prompt README · HTTP API：Target keys are `global` and `ws:<workspaceId>`. A workspace key must name a
**registered** workspace id — the panel cannot be pointed at an arbitrary path,
and an unknown id is a 404, not a filesystem probe. `content` is the whole file
body; a missing file reads as an empty string, and a write creates missing parent
directories.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Configuration：None. The plugin has no Loader config, no settings section and no stored state:
the files on disk are the state.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Architecture：| Module | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | host plugin body: one `ctx.effect` registering the route family |
| `src/routes.ts` | the `/api/agent-prompt` routes, the loopback/method/body fences, target resolution |
| `src/files.ts` | harness-home resolution, `.git` project-root walk, file stat/read/write |
| `src/protocol.ts` | the wire contract both halves import (paths + JSON shapes) |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | browser plugin body: locale dictionaries + the two slot registrations |
| `src/client/AgentPromptPanel.tsx` | the page: draft, dirty flag, load/save, tree↔editor wiring |
| `src/client/PromptTree.tsx` | the left tree and its filter |
| `src/client/PromptEditor.tsx` | the textarea, its toolbar and its undo history |
| `src/client/version.ts` | the build-time-inlined version the title tag shows |
| `src/client/api.ts`, `styles.ts`, `locales.ts`, `translate.ts` | fetch wrappers, injected CSS, `en`/`zh` copy |

dsh-agent-prompt README · Architecture：The workspace registry is read through `ctx.get('workspaceRegistry')` rather than
a hard inject: without it the routes still mount and the global file still works,
and only the per-workspace targets answer 503.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Develop：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check     # tsc (host + client) then vitest
pnpm build     # tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsdown
pnpm test

`lib/` and `dist/` are build products and are not committed.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Preview harness：`tools/preview.mjs` renders the built client bundle outside the GUI and
screenshots it: it loads `lib/client.js` through a stub `window.__ModuleLoader__`,
calls the plugin's `apply` with a minimal fake client context, mounts the `main`
entry, and replays a captured tree through a stubbed `fetch`.

```sh
node tools/preview.mjs --out /tmp/ap-preview      # writes index.html + panel.png
node tools/preview.mjs --open                     # ...and opens the PNG
```

dsh-agent-prompt README · Preview harness：It needs Google Chrome (or Chromium/Edge) on the host, plus the `react` and
`react-dom` dev dependencies (the UMD builds the harness page loads). This is how
the panel's layout and stylesheet are checked without a browser session in the
running app.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Verification：| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm typecheck` — host half | clean |
| `pnpm typecheck` — client half | clean; both `slots.register` calls are checked against the real `SlotMap`, so the `main` and `sidebar.panellist` ids, and the `agentPrompt` locale namespace, are compile-time facts |
| `vitest run` | **25/25 pass** |
| live host: `GET /api/agent-prompt/tree` | `200`, with the harness home resolved to `~/.dsh` and one node per registered workspace carrying its real `projectRoot` |
| live client: Cordis Inspect `Slots` → `sidebar.panellist` | occupant `agentPrompt`, `order: 11`, `active: true` |
| live client: Cordis Inspect `Slots` → `main` | occupant `agentPrompt`, `active: true` |
| preview render | the title + version tag, the tree, the toolbar, the editor and the status bar paint as designed. The harness also **fails the render** when `lib/client.js` does not carry the manifest version, which is the only check on the inlining |

dsh-agent-prompt README · Verification：`test/files.spec.ts` (13 tests) exercises path resolution against a real temporary
filesystem — the `$DSH_HOME` precedence including the blank-string case, the `.git`
walk including the worktree `.git`-file form, and the missing-file/directory-in-file-
position cases. `test/routes.spec.ts` (10 tests) serves the real route handlers from
a real loopback HTTP server and drives them with `fetch`: tree shape, nested
workspace → repository root, read of a missing file, unknown target key, unknown
workspace, create-and-round-trip for both the global and workspace files, and the
method fence. Nothing about the handler bodies is stubbed. `test/version.spec.ts`
(2 tests) covers the one trap in the version module: it must stay importable where
the build-time define is absent. `test/protocol.spec.ts` (5 tests) resolves the
panel's request paths against a root base and against a mounted one, which is the
only check that would catch a request escaping a path prefix.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Verification：Not covered by an automated test: an end-to-end write against the live host (the
route tests write into a temporary directory instead, so no real `AGENTS.md` is
touched), and the platform clipboard shortcuts, which belong to the browser
rather than to this plugin.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Caveats：- **`AGENTS.md` only** — `CLAUDE.md` and the `.local` overlays are not offered.
- **No live reload of external edits.** The page reads a file when you select it
  or press Reload. If something else changes the file while the page is open,
  saving overwrites it; there is no mtime check or merge.
- **The routes are reachable by any local process**, like every other
  loopback-fenced plugin API in this composition. They are not covered by the web
  app's `?token=` launch token, because named routes are matched before the
  authenticated SPA fallback.
- **A pinned `dshHome` in the agent-instructions config would diverge** from the
  panel's `$DSH_HOME || ~/.dsh` resolution. The shipped composition pins only
  `maxBytes`, so the two agree today.

dsh-agent-prompt README · Contributing：Issues and pull requests are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for the development setup and the sign-off expectation. Please report security
issues privately as described in [SECURITY.md](.github/SECURITY.md).

dsh-agent-prompt README · dsh-agent-prompt：DSH 会在每个会话开始时注入工作区指引，内容取自与 `AGENTS.md` 兼容的文件：
一个用户全局文件，外加一条项目链。平时改这些文件，得开外部编辑器、进终端，
一次只处理一个路径。本插件把它们收进同一个页面：左边是全部全局与各工作区
指令文件的树，右边是纯文本编辑器，再加上一个 Save 按钮——它写下的正是 agent
下个会话将要读到的那些字节。

dsh-agent-prompt README · dsh-agent-prompt：```
┌── Agent Prompt ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Filter workspaces…    │  ~/workspace/dsh-plugins/AGENTS.md                │
│                        │    ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  GLOBAL                │    │ Save  Reload │ Undo Redo │ Wrap           │  │

dsh-agent-prompt README · 它贡献了什么：| 界面 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 侧边栏行 **Agent Prompt** | 图标栏里的一行全局面板，就排在 **Schedules** 正下方 |
| **Agent Prompt** 页面 | 左侧文件树（全局 + 每个已注册工作区一个节点，带过滤器）和右侧编辑器 |
| `GET /api/agent-prompt/tree` | 解析后的文件清单，含每个文件的存在性、大小和 mtime |
| `GET /api/agent-prompt/file?key=…` | 读取一个指令文件 |
| `POST /api/agent-prompt/file` | 写入一个指令文件，文件或其目录缺失时一并创建 |

dsh-agent-prompt README · 它贡献了什么：这些是**宿主**路径，保持绝对形式；面板则相对文档去请求它们（`AGENT_PROMPT_CLIENT_API`，由 `src/protocol.ts` 里的 `clientPath()` 从 `AGENT_PROMPT_API` 派生）。客户端不是挂在源根时，这个区别才要紧：`dsh-remote-control` 把它伺服在 `/s/<sessionId>/` 下，而一个绝对 `/api/…` 请求会离开这个前缀、被它自己的宿主应答——那是一个 `200 text/html` 页面，而 `request()` 容忍非 JSON 响应体，所以这个面板会把它读成一次没有响应体的成功。`test/protocol.spec.ts` 对着一个挂载了 base 的地址解析这两种形式，把这个行为钉住。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 它编辑哪些文件，以及为什么是这些：宿主这一半用与加载这些文件的包
[`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions)
完全相同的规则解析路径。它随包发布的默认值是
`projectRootMarkers: ['.git']`、`instructionFileCandidates: ['AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md']`
和 `dshHome: $DSH_HOME || ~/.dsh`；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 里的 `agent-instructions`
行只设置了 `maxBytes`，所以这套部署里没有任何路径被覆盖。
section: 它编辑哪些文件，以及为什么是这些

text:
dsh-agent-prompt README · 它编辑哪些文件，以及为什么是这些：| 节点 | 解析规则 |
|---|---|
| **用户全局** | `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`，回退到 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`。空或全空白的 `$DSH_HOME` 都算作未设置，与加载器保持一致。 |
| **某个工作区** | 从已注册的工作区目录向上走，直到第一个含 `.git` 的祖先目录；文件即 `<that directory>/AGENTS.md`。一路都没有标记时，向上查找终止于工作区目录本身。 |

树中每个节点都显示解析后的绝对路径，文件尚不存在时会标上 `not created`
——保存即创建它。如果某个工作区的项目根与它自身的目录不同（比如 monorepo
里的一个包），显示的是它的仓库根，而不是那个包。

**只提供 `AGENTS.md`。** 加载器在项目链的每一层还接受 `CLAUDE.md`、
`AGENTS.local.md` 和 `CLAUDE.local.md`，并且同样会编辑它们。这些不在本插件的
范围内；这个面板刻意做到每个作用域只对应一个文件。
section: 它编辑哪些文件，以及为什么是这些

text:
dsh-agent-prompt README · 页面：两处注册，key 都是 `agentPrompt`：

| Slot | 注册 | 效果 |
|---|---|---|
| `sidebar.panellist` | `id: 'agentPrompt'`、`order: 11` | 那一行图标 |
| `main` | `key: 'agentPrompt'` | 该行在中间栏打开的页面 |

页面标题带着面板版本和作者署名——`Agent Prompt v0.1.3 Author: icrefin [icrefinai@gmail.com]`——作为 `20px/500` 标题旁的一枚弱化标签，与 `dsh-skill-mgr`、`dsh-mcp-mgr` 一致。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 页面：与那两个不同，**这个版本号是构建时内联进浏览器 bundle 的**，而不是从宿主取。
一个插件的前后两半并不同步更新：浏览器 bundle 一旦 revision 变化就立刻被重新
导入，而宿主这一半是启动时的 ESM 导入，会一直提供进程启动时载入的那份代码。
所以只要客户端跑到了正在运行的宿主前面，从宿主取来的标签就会变空——这个面板
当初渲染出一个光秃秃的 `v`，就是这么来的。`tsdown.config.ts` 读取 `package.json`
并定义 `__DSH_AGENT_PROMPT_VERSION__`；`src/client/version.ts` 导出它，值为空时
该标签直接不渲染。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 页面：选择这一行调用的是 `ctx.layout.selectPanel('agentPrompt')`，即在运行中的 `main`
注册表里做一次查找，因此两者从构造上就共用同一个 id。`dsh.client.inject` 把
bundle 排在 `dsh-client-ui-sidebar` 和 `dsh-client-ui-layout` 之后，也就是声明
这两个 slot 的那两个包之后。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 编辑器命令：| 命令 | 快捷键 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Save | `⌘S` / `Ctrl+S` **页面任意位置** | 草稿与磁盘内容一致前禁用 |
| Reload | — | 丢弃草稿并重新读取文件；有未保存修改时先弹确认 |
| Undo / Redo | `⌘Z` / `⇧⌘Z`（原生） | 本地历史记录，因为平台的撤销栈无法由按钮驱动；一串连续输入会折叠成一步 |
| Wrap | — | 软换行开关，记录在 `localStorage` 里 |

剪贴板**一个按钮都没有**：`⌘X`、`⌘C`、`⌘V` 和 `⌘A` 本来就能到达获得焦点的
textarea，而在工具栏上放一份可用平台快捷键的副本纯属噪音。剩下的，恰好就是
textarea 自己够不到的那些。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 样式契约：- **颜色只用 `--dsw-alias-*`**——样式表里没有任何字面 hex，也没有非 alias 的
  token。状态芯片是自身状态色叠在 10% 的 `color-mix(… transparent)` 着色上；
  表面用的是 `bg-layer-1`（树那一列）、`bg-layer-3`（编辑器输入区）和
  `bg-module-platform`（过滤器、芯片）。
- **按钮**用契约里的两族：中性按钮是 8px/12.5px 的裸控件，悬停时依次填充
  `interactive-bg-hover` → `-active`；主操作 Save 用 `button-primary-fill`/`-hover`
  配 `label-primary-foreground`。`brand-primary` 只出现在 `:focus-visible` 描边上
  ——从不作为填充色。
- **字体与几何**：标题 20px/500/28，简介 13px/20，芯片 11px；header 自带
  `padding-top: 28px`，在 Darwin 下还要加上 `--dsh-frame-top-clearance`；页面的
  横向节奏是 `clamp(24px, 4vw, 48px)`。
- **页面根节点上的 `color-scheme: light dark`**，没有任何暗色模式覆盖：token
  本身就同时承载两种模式。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 样式契约：两栏主体是唯一一处刻意的偏离：契约描述的是居中的 960px 单栏页面，而那样会把
「树 + 编辑器」的分栏饿死。header 保留契约的内缩，好让标题与它的兄弟面板对齐，
主体则在它下方满宽铺开。

编辑器就是一个等宽字体的普通 `<textarea>`：没有 Markdown 预览，也没有语法
高亮。带着未保存修改切换文件会先询问，带着未保存修改关闭窗口会触发浏览器
自己的卸载提示。保存或重新读取都会开启一段全新的撤销历史，所以 Undo 永远
不可能退回到宿主从未见过的那份内容。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 安装：桌面 profile 归 Electron 应用所有，所以安装要走 **Settings → Plugins**（或者
插件管理器工具）；`dsh plugin add` 会拒绝这个 profile。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build                              # tsc -> lib/, tsdown -> lib/client.js
npm pack --pack-destination dist        # dist/dsh-agent-prompt-0.1.2.tgz
```

然后在 Plugins 页面添加 `dist/dsh-agent-prompt-0.1.2.tgz`。这个 bundle 会被记录
进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，它的 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入行负责挂载宿主
这一半；`dsh.client` manifest 字段则加载浏览器这一半。

两条运维上的注意事项：

dsh-agent-prompt README · 安装：- **重装同一个版本等于什么都没做。** pnpm 看到 spec 没变，就放着 `node_modules`
  里已解压的那份不管，所以同一版本下重新构建的 tarball 到不了 profile。先移除
  这个 bundle，再装一次——或者把版本号往上提。
- **首次安装不需要重启；已加载插件的更新，只要涉及宿主侧改动就需要。** 首次
  安装时，宿主路由挂载和浏览器半注册都在安装完成后立刻生效，页面都不用刷新。
  此后两半就开始分道扬镳：浏览器 bundle 会按其新 revision 重新导入，但**宿主
  这一半是启动时的 ESM 导入**，会一直提供进程启动时载入的那份代码。宿主侧
  改动——比如某个路由新增一个字段——只有在下次启动时才会抵达正在运行的应用；
  客户端改动则永远不需要重启。这是上游行为，不是本插件的：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr`
  写得很清楚："replacing installed package versions still requires a restart"。
  如果某个条目报 `failed to import`，就重启。

dsh-agent-prompt README · HTTP API：两条路由都注册在 `ctx.webServer` 上，并带一道**仅限回环的围栏**：写路由会重写
一个被 agent 当作指令读取的文件，所以暴露在局域网上的 `dsh web` 部署绝不能
提供它。请求另外还有 4 MiB 的上限。

```
GET  /api/agent-prompt/tree
     -> { dshHome, homeDisplay, global: Node, workspaces: Node[], skipped: string[] }

GET  /api/agent-prompt/file?key=global|ws:<workspaceId>

目标 key 是 `global` 和 `ws:<workspaceId>`。工作区 key 必须指向一个**已注册**的
工作区 id——面板无法被指向任意路径，未知 id 返回 404，而不是去探测文件系统。
`content` 是整个文件正文；文件不存在时读出来是空字符串，写入则会创建缺失的
父目录。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 配置：无。这个插件没有 Loader 配置、没有设置区块，也没有持久状态：磁盘上的文件
就是状态。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 架构：| 模块 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | 宿主插件主体：一个 `ctx.effect`，注册整族路由 |
| `src/routes.ts` | `/api/agent-prompt` 路由、回环/方法/请求体三道围栏、目标解析 |
| `src/files.ts` | harness home 解析、`.git` 项目根向上查找、文件 stat/读/写 |
| `src/protocol.ts` | 两半共同 import 的线上契约（路径 + JSON 形状） |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | 浏览器插件主体：locale 字典 + 两处 slot 注册 |
| `src/client/AgentPromptPanel.tsx` | 页面：草稿、dirty 标记、加载/保存、树↔编辑器接线 |
| `src/client/PromptTree.tsx` | 左侧文件树及其过滤器 |
| `src/client/PromptEditor.tsx` | textarea、它的工具栏和撤销历史 |
| `src/client/version.ts` | 标题标签所显示的、构建时内联的版本 |
| `src/client/api.ts`, `styles.ts`, `locales.ts`, `translate.ts` | fetch 包装、注入的 CSS、`en`/`zh` 文案 |

dsh-agent-prompt README · 架构：工作区注册表是通过 `ctx.get('workspaceRegistry')` 读的，而不是硬 inject：没有
它，路由照样挂载、全局文件照样可用，只有按工作区的目标会返回 503。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 开发：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check     # tsc (host + client) then vitest
pnpm build     # tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsdown
pnpm test

`lib/` 和 `dist/` 是构建产物，不提交。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 预览工具：`tools/preview.mjs` 在 GUI 之外渲染构建好的客户端 bundle 并给它截图：它通过
一个桩 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 加载 `lib/client.js`，用一份最小的假客户端
context 调用插件的 `apply`，挂载 `main` 条目，再通过桩掉的 `fetch` 回放一份
抓取下来的树。

```sh
node tools/preview.mjs --out /tmp/ap-preview      # writes index.html + panel.png
node tools/preview.mjs --open                     # ...and opens the PNG
```

它需要宿主机上有 Google Chrome（或 Chromium/Edge），以及 `react` 和 `react-dom`
两个 dev 依赖（预览页加载的正是它们的 UMD 构建）。这就是在运行中的应用里没有
浏览器会话时，检查面板布局与样式表的方式。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 验证：| 检查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `pnpm typecheck` —— 宿主这一半 | 无错误 |
| `pnpm typecheck` —— 客户端这一半 | 无错误；两处 `slots.register` 调用都对照真实的 `SlotMap` 做类型检查，所以 `main` 与 `sidebar.panellist` 的 id、以及 `agentPrompt` locale 命名空间，都是编译期事实 |
| `vitest run` | **25/25 通过** |
| 实机宿主：`GET /api/agent-prompt/tree` | `200`，harness home 解析为 `~/.dsh`，每个已注册工作区一个节点，携带其真实的 `projectRoot` |
| 实机客户端：Cordis Inspect `Slots` → `sidebar.panellist` | 占用者 `agentPrompt`、`order: 11`、`active: true` |

dsh-agent-prompt README · 验证：`test/files.spec.ts`（13 个测试）针对真实的临时文件系统演练路径解析——包括
空字符串情形在内的 `$DSH_HOME` 优先级、包括 worktree `.git` 文件形式在内的
`.git` 向上查找，以及文件缺失、文件位置上出现目录这些情形。`test/routes.spec.ts`
（10 个测试）用真实的回环 HTTP 服务器伺服真实的路由处理函数，并用 `fetch`
驱动它们：树形状、嵌套工作区 → 仓库根、读取不存在的文件、未知目标 key、未知
工作区、全局与工作区文件的创建与往返读写，以及方法围栏。处理函数主体没有任何
一处被桩掉。`test/version.spec.ts`（2 个测试）覆盖版本模块里唯一的那个坑：
在构建期 define 缺席的地方，它必须仍然可 import。 `test/protocol.spec.ts`（5 个测试）把面板的请求路径
分别对着源根 base 和挂载 base 解析，这是唯一能抓住请求逃出路径前缀的检查。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 验证：没有自动化测试覆盖的部分：针对实机宿主的端到端写入（路由测试改为写进临时
目录，所以不会碰到真实的 `AGENTS.md`），以及平台剪贴板快捷键——它们属于
浏览器，而不属于本插件。

dsh-agent-prompt README · 注意事项：- **只支持 `AGENTS.md`**——`CLAUDE.md` 和 `.local` 叠加文件都不提供。
- **不会实时感知外部改动。** 页面只在你选中某个文件或按 Reload 时读取它。
  如果页面打开期间别的东西改了这个文件，保存会直接覆盖它；没有 mtime 检查，
  也没有合并。
- **这些路由对本机任何进程都可达**，与这套组合里其他所有带回环围栏的插件
  API 一样。它们不受 web 应用 `?token=` 启动令牌的保护，因为具名路由会先于
  需要认证的 SPA 回退匹配。
- **在 agent-instructions 配置里钉死 `dshHome` 会与**面板的 `$DSH_HOME || ~/.dsh`
  解析产生分歧。随包发布的组合只钉了 `maxBytes`，所以今天两者是一致的。
